name: Sambhv Steel Tubes Limited
summary: Sambhv Steel Tubes Limited manufactures and sells electrical resistance welded steel pipes, structural tubes, and stainless-steel coils in India. The company provides mild steel hot-rolled coil, cold rolled coil, and galvanized coils; ERW steel tubes and pipes, including rectangular tubes, round tubes, and square tubes; cold rolled full hard pipes, comprising rectangular pipes, round pipes, and square pipes; and steel door frames, which comprise single, double, and four door frames.
